subject: IrisHealth MAP: commitments, stakeholders & onboarding schedule
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@irishealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: IrisHealth MAP: commitments, stakeholders & onboarding schedule

Hi Asha — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) based on our call: 

Key pain & goals (as we heard):
- Latency and cost spikes on your triage workflows (50–60% of queries are short but currently batched inefficiently).
- Need predictable per-call latency for clinician-facing features (SLO: < 200ms tail for 95th percentile).
- Data residency and auditability requirements for PHI-adjacent metadata.

Success criteria you described:
- Pilot serving 5k sessions/day with consistent P95 latency under 200ms and monthly spend under $X (your target).
- Integration with your ingestion pipeline and ability to pin model versions for A/B.

Proposed MAP / milestones (draft):
1) Scope & tech alignment (this week) — confirm sample payloads, sequence lengths, and any PII handling rules. Owner: Asha + Monica. Target: 2027-03-15
2) Pilot environment setup (Redwood Dedicated sandbox) — infra sketch + credentials exchange. Owner: Ben. Target: 2027-03-22
3) Validation run (5–7 day load window) — collect latency/cost telemetry and quality checks against your prompt set. Owner: Ben + Iris eng. Target: 2027-04-05
4) Commercial/PO & rollout plan — finalize pricing and procurement path; sign PO. Owner: Asha (procurement) + Soojin. Target: 2027-04-12

Stakeholders (as called out):
- IrisHealth: Asha (product sponsor), Devon (engineering lead), Procurement team (procurement@irishealth.ai)
- Redwood: Soojin (AE), Ben (Solutions/infra), Monica (Customer Success)

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Asha: confirm stakeholder availability for a 30-min technical alignment this Friday (3/12) and whether procurement needs a vendor packet (we have SOC2 + dataflow diagram).
- Iris: share a small sample (anonymized) of 100 request payloads and the prompt templates you’ll use in pilot (secure upload link in Drive works).
- Redwood: we’ll share a one-page MAP PDF and an infra sketch; Ben will propose a sandbox window.

Attached: IrisHealth_MAP_draft_20270310.pdf (MAP draft), infra-sketch-iris-01.png (high-level diagram).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once you confirm Friday availability.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com


From: Asha Patel <asha@irishealth.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@irishealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IrisHealth MAP: commitments, stakeholders & onboarding schedule

Thanks Soojin — this is very clear and matches our notes. Quick replies inline: 

- Friday 3/12 10:00–10:30 PT works for a tech alignment (Devon will join).
- We can share a 100-sample anonymized payload set via the secure Drive folder by EOD Friday.
- Procurement: yes, we will need your SOC 2 report and a vendor security questionnaire filled out — I’ve looped them in.

On the commercial timeline: procurement typically needs ~2 weeks after we get the vendor packet. If we start the validation run week of 3/22, PO could be ready ~4/12 — that aligns with your MAP.

I’ll confirm attendee names once Devon’s calendar is finalized.

Asha Patel
Head of Product, IrisHealth
asha@irishealth.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@irishealth.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IrisHealth MAP: commitments, stakeholders & onboarding schedule

Great — thanks Asha. For the tech alignment I’ll bring a short checklist so we can size the sandbox correctly. Preview:

- Expected token / sequence length distribution (median / 95th)
- Typical prompt/response size and whether responses are trimmed or post-processed
- Any KV cache reuse patterns (session affinity?)
- Data retention and audit log requirements (log retention window, redact rules)

I’ve provisioned a candidate sandbox window 3/22–3/29 (we can shift if you need a different week). I’ll attach a brief runbook after the call with endpoints and keys (no creds in email).

Ben Carter
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Asha Patel <asha@irishealth.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@irishealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Mar 2027 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IrisHealth MAP: commitments, stakeholders & onboarding schedule

Appreciate the follow-ups — confirmation from our side: 

- Tech alignment call confirmed for Fri 3/12 10:00 PT (Devon joining).
- Secure Drive folder uploaded with 100 anonymized payloads (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_MAP-draft-iris).
- Procurement: we’ve reviewed the vendor packet you sent and procurement will prepare PO after the validation run; projected PO approval by 2027-04-11.

Procurement question (copied to team): can Redwood accept a 60-day net payment term for the initial pilot PO and standalone SOW? If so, we’re ready to move forward with the validation window on 3/22.

Asha Patel
Head of Product, IrisHealth
